summary: Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir was taken into police custody on 11 December 2025 during a fishermen's protest at sea near Jetty No. 1 in Malé. Parliament's Committee on Members' Privileges and Ethics reviewed letters from MPs, the MP's own complaint and replies from the Maldives Police Service. The committee decided unanimously that his privileges as an MP were not breached when he was detained. Parliament passed the committee's report on 26 October 2026.
keyPoints: Police said he was arrested for disobeying security forces' orders and obstructing police duties; the Criminal Court ordered 5 days' remand from 12 December 2025.
MPs Ahmed Shakir (Maavashu) and Ameen Faisal (Kanditheemu) wrote that the protest was peaceful and the arrest unlawful with excessive force.
Police said he was seen by doctors in custody, taken to IGMH on 13 December 2025, and released from custody on medical advice.
Committee decision made at its 7th meeting of 2026 on 19 October 2026.
Parliament vote on the report: 46 yes, 10 no, 0 abstentions.
outcome: Report passed by Parliament on 26 October 2026
